findings.text: follow-on: the focused gate and head arm are logged at revision f497c5eb9, one commit behind the run head e0221456c; the final commit e0221456c is docs-only so the code measured is identical, but the gate was not re-run at the exact promoted revision.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 5c7f69358: fa76fa3b7 adds _seen_at/_current_scan/_fresh_cached_paths and the seen ordinal, 48e75e699 is format-only, f497c5eb9 adds _repository_key/_corpus_directory and the repo= parameter so promotion keys the cache by the git common dir, and abcaefcbb/e0221456c add only the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the declared measure asks a test that scans a corpus, removes one file, runs scans past the span, and asserts the removed entry is gone while the entry count equals the current corpus, plus a partial-scan case that re-parses nothing; tests/test_a_removed_file_leaves_the_clone_cache.py:133 and :156 are those cases and I re-ran the node test at head (4 passed, EXIT=0).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a file removed or renamed out of the clone-scan corpus stops holding a cache entry; reckon/clones.py:301 (_fresh_cached_paths) counts a cached path toward the prune cap only while scan - _seen_at < _STALE_PATH_SCANS (reckon/clones.py:71), so a departed path stops counting and the LRU prune at reckon/clones.py:594 evicts its entry.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the node test 4 passed, a focused gate of the node test plus five suites 25 passed EXIT=0, base and head arms of the five named suites 21 passed EXIT=0 with zero added failures, and two negative controls each 1 failed EXIT=1; its baseline_suite and after_suite both completed with failure_count 0.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/clones.py, tests/test_a_removed_file_leaves_the_clone_cache.py and the evidence fragment; git diff --name-status 5c7f69358 e0221456c lists exactly those three, so the diff stays inside the fence.

justifications.durability: reinstating the pre-change counted-path cap reddens the removed-file case at tests/test_a_removed_file_leaves_the_clone_cache.py:147, and sharing one cache reddens test_one_repository_scan_does_not_age_another at :188, but the goal's renamed half is exercised only indirectly through the removal case.
justifications.evidence: the node gate and both arms completed with 0 failures and I reproduced the node test (4 passed, EXIT=0), but gate.log and the head arm measure f497c5eb9 rather than the final head e0221456c (docs-only), so the gate was not re-run at the exact head.
justifications.fit: helpers are mechanism-named (_STALE_PATH_SCANS, _fresh_cached_paths, _corpus_directory) with no plan or sprint label, and the module docstring states the resulting bound at reckon/clones.py:41-52.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the removed-or-renamed path stops counting toward the cap and is evicted within _STALE_PATH_SCANS+1 scans, and clone_matches retains the same matches a cold scan reports (reckon/clones.py:301, :594).
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches only reckon/clones.py, tests/test_a_removed_file_leaves_the_clone_cache.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared write paths, with no figure the node did not name.
